name: Lough Ree

attributes.attribute: lake formed by the River Shannon
said to hold a city in its depths
killed on the shores of Lough Ree by her nephew

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Lough Ree is a lake formed by the great River Shannon in Ireland. People say a city lies in its depths and can be seen on clear days. On the shores of Lough Ree, the queen and goddess Medb met her death. Her nephew Furbaide Ferbend killed her there as revenge. Medb had earlier murdered her own sister, Clothra, who was the mother of Furbaide. His killing of Medb answered that earlier slaying.

okr.objective: Document Lough Ree as a Shannon lake tied to the death of the queen Medb.
